create_cost_complexity_pruning_path: create a cost complexity pruning path to find effective alphas and leaf impurities for a decision tree
build_decision_tree_classifier: build a DecisionTreeClassifier with ccp_alpha parameter to control tree pruning and prevent overfitting
test_decision_tree_accuracy: test a pruned decision tree on training and testing sets to compare accuracy across different ccp_alpha values
plot_pruning_results: plot total leaf impurity, node count, tree depth, and accuracy versus effective alpha for cost complexity pruning
summarize_tree_structure: summarize the number of nodes and max depth of pruned decision trees for various ccp_alpha values
